- **Bacterial_Speck_Of_Tomato**: "Small angular (straight-edged) spots with yellow halos; substantial leaf curling may also be present" — the curled leaf, dark angular spots, and distribution match well.
- **Tomato_Spotted_Wilt_Virus**: Mentions bronzing and downward-cupped leaves with blurred margins — no visible bronzing here.
- **Septoria_Leaf_Blotch**: Tan to gray circular lesions — lesions here are darker, not tan/gray.
- **Early_Blight**: Larger dark brown lesions with concentric rings — no concentric rings visible.

The combination of dark angular spots and prominent leaf curling most closely matches **Bacterial_Speck_Of_Tomato**.
